=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:196 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The sandbox-excluded escalation guard `[ ! -s "${COMMITTED_FILES_FILE:-/dev/null}" ]` assumes the committed-files file is empty when nothing was committed, but scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:527-529 writes `- none` (and lines 116/131/151 write `- commit skipped (...)` / `- none (edits withheld for safety: ...)`), so the guard is never true on a real no-change run.
  WHY: Reviewer rated it BLOCKER. The escalation never fires in production, so no marker is written, no `AUTOFIX_SANDBOX_EXCLUDED_ESCALATION` line is logged and the cap never trips, which means the #8250 29-re-review loop is still open. Tests hide this because `_run_step` defaults to `committed=""`.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:198-214 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The awk `trail` regex used in `sub(trail, "", value)` strips only one trailing character, so a bullet ending in `"sandbox-excluded path".` keeps its closing quote and fails the end-anchored `/sandbox-excluded path$/` match.
  WHY: Both reviewers rated it BLOCKER. On a PR-#8250-shaped summary the count stays 0, so no `review-autofix-failure:v1` marker is written, the cap never trips and the loop keeps running; z-ai says `test_pr_8250_shaped_summary_trips_the_cap_on_the_next_dispatch` fails on this head. Disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 checked this claim and dropped it as wrong, saying the ERE `[] \t."'`)*]+$` has a `+` quantifier, so one `sub()` removes the whole trailing run.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1470-1476 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_non_retryable_route_apply` has no branch for the new `review_editor_sandbox_path_excluded` reason, so with `paths == []` it falls through to `NON_RETRYABLE_ACTION="the conflicted path(s) need a manual merge"`, which the Telegram WARNING at line 1511 then uses.
  WHY: Three reviewers rated it MAJOR and openai_gpt-6-luna rated it NIT (highest used). On every cap trip the operator is told to merge conflicts that do not exist, while the PR comment correctly says to make the sandbox-excluded change by hand. The file is outside the plan's files_touched grant.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:1277 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The new tests/test_review_editor_sandbox_excluded_escalation.py is not run by any workflow step and is not in UNWIRED_ALLOWLIST, so tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py:60 (test_every_test_file_runs_in_a_workflow) fails.
  WHY: Reviewer rated it BLOCKER. static-checks fails on head 80d353ae with `assert not ['tests/test_review_editor_sandbox_excluded_escalation.py']` and the aggregate lint job fails, so the PR cannot merge and the marker/cap tests never run in CI.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:139 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `[ ! -s "${COMMITTED_FILES_FILE:-/dev/null}" ]` is true when COMMITTED_FILES_FILE is unset.
  WHY: Reviewer rated it NIT. If a caller leaves the variable unset, a run that did commit could be misclassified as an escalation candidate. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dropped this as forward-looking hygiene with no current failing caller.
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:378 (snapshot(); sidecar `.admitted_commands.json` line ~270) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The local `commands` set, the `load_admitted_commands` regex and the `.admitted_commands.json` sidecar now hold both `.claude/commands/` and `.claude/docs/` entries, so their names no longer match their contents.
  WHY: Both reviewers rated it NIT. A future consumer that assumes the sidecar holds only commands would silently miss docs entries; no current consumer is broken. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dropped it, and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 called it style-only (callers are only review_untrusted_workspace.py:452 and :590).
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:381-384, 464-483 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The frozen docs inventory is built from the intersection of template-twin names without requiring the live `.claude/docs/<name>.md` file to exist at snapshot time, and `transfer()` accepts a new admitted result when the host path does not exist.
  WHY: Reviewer rated it MAJOR. The editor can create an absent live `.claude/docs/` file and transfer it to the host, which breaks the stated rule against creating new `.claude/docs/` files. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked the docs admission path and considered it fail-closed.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Every test file runs in some workflow"; the new tests/test_review_editor_sandbox_excluded_escalation.py (Signal, Cap and Regression tests, including the PR #8250 regression) must be wired into CI.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml step "Review autofix review-pipeline plumbing contract test" (ci.yml:1269-1279, ~line 1277), or a justified entry in tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py::UNWIRED_ALLOWLIST
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No PR hunk touches .github/workflows/ci.yml, no workflow names tests/test_review_editor_sandbox_excluded_escalation.py, and UNWIRED_ALLOWLIST is empty. static-checks on 80d353ae (run 40817493295) failed at tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py:60 with `assert not ['tests/test_review_editor_sandbox_excluded_escalation.py']`, and lint failed with "CI jobs that did not succeed: static-checks".
- requirement: "A run that makes no change, and lists at least one finding as `sandbox-excluded path`, writes one `review-autofix-failure:v1` marker with reason `review_editor_sandbox_path_excluded`. The next run for the same head trips the cap." / "Regression: with a summary shaped like PR #8250's last editor comment, the cap trips on the following dispatch."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh (committed-files guard at line 196) and tests/test_review_editor_sandbox_excluded_escalation.py (`_run_step` default `committed=""`)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: The detector requires COMMITTED_FILES_FILE to be empty, but review_commit_changes.sh:529 always writes `- none` on a no-change run before this step runs, and the regression test feeds an empty committed-files file that the pipeline never produces.
- requirement: "Admission: extend the existing allowed() tests (the review and heal-editor workspace suites, for example tests/test_codex_agent_isolation_contract.py and tests/test_heal_isolated_editor.py)."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_heal_isolated_editor.py (heal-editor strict-mode path through enumerate_workspace)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: Admission coverage was added only in tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py (test_review_isolation_admits_only_twinned_claude_docs), and neither heal-editor suite has a hunk adding a `.claude/docs/` admission case under strict heal enumeration.
- requirement: The new `review_editor_sandbox_path_excluded` reason must produce a complete non-retryable cap: one label, one comment, one heal report, and no operator paged to manually merge conflicts that do not exist.
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh, `_non_retryable_route_apply` (~lines 1470-1476) and its fallback WARNING at ~line 1511
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The Python side was updated (`NON_RETRYABLE_FAILURE_REASONS`, `_NON_RETRYABLE_EXPLANATIONS`, and `render_non_retryable_comment` at scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:4894), but the shell side has no branch for the new reason and the PR diff touches no shell file in this area.
- requirement: The pre-push gate's seven "Failures caused by this change" must not regress (tests/test_ai_label_precreation_contract.py, two tests/test_changelog_fragment_contract.py cases, tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py, ten tests/test_promote_main_cycle.py cases, tests/test_review_semble_contract.py, ruff); the gate must be green to deliver.
  expected_change_site: the failing suites under tests/ and the ruff step under static-checks
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No PR hunk modifies those test files or the ruff config, and no shared fixture change can explain them. Only the tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py failure is proven by the trusted check-run log; the rest come from the untrusted gate report and could not be mapped to a hunk. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 dropped the ruff item because the ruff step was not reached and the new code shows no E/F violation.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:line 196, `if [ "${editor_summary_is_real}" = "1" ] && [ ! -s "${COMMITTED_FILES_FILE:-/dev/null}" ]; then` | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The guard treats "nothing committed" as an empty COMMITTED_FILES_FILE, but scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:527-529 writes `- none` and lines 116, 131 and 151 write placeholder lines. The commit step (review_autofix.yml:3737) runs before "Post editor summary comment" (review_autofix.yml:3833).
  WHY: The escalation never fires in production: no marker, no log line, no cap trip, so the #8250 loop is still open. Tests hide this through `_run_step` `committed=""`, and the agents.d and changelog fragments repeat the wrong assumption. Fix: detect a non-placeholder `- <path>` line, and change the tests' default to `"- none\n"`.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:_non_retryable_route_apply, lines 1470-1476, used in the tg_send_msg WARNING at line 1511 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: There is no branch for `review_editor_sandbox_path_excluded`. With `paths == []` the chain falls through to `else` with the text "the conflicted path(s) need a manual merge".
  WHY: The operator's Telegram WARNING points to a nonexistent conflict. Fix is a 2-line `elif`. The file is outside files_touched.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:"Review autofix review-pipeline plumbing contract test" step, line 1277; enforced by tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py:60 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: tests/test_review_editor_sandbox_excluded_escalation.py is not run by any workflow and is not in UNWIRED_ALLOWLIST.
  WHY: static-checks fails on head 80d353ae and lint fails, so the PR cannot merge. Fix: add a pytest invocation next to line 1277.
